summary.zh: 为大型代码库优化 Bazel 构建与远程执行
summary.en: Tune Bazel builds and remote execution for large repos

description.zh: 讲解 Bazel 配置、构建图优化以及远程执行与远程缓存设置，用于缩短企业级代码库的构建时间。适合构建变慢、缓存命中率低或需要接入远程执行时使用。远程执行需要可用的执行平台。
description.en: Covers Bazel configuration, build graph tuning, and remote execution and caching to cut build times in large codebases. Remote execution needs an available execution platform.
